open_points.subject: _run_backup
open_points.text: _run_backup: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST touch in backup_dir only regular files directly in it whose name begins with the imported BACKUP_KEPT_PREFIX constant or the imported BACKUP_TEMPORARY_PREFIX constant, MUST follow no symbolic link, opening every file through _open_without_link, and enter no directory there, and MUST create each temporary file exclusively under the temporary prefix with a name no other file has; it MUST write nothing to the store and make no audit entry.
open_points.other_text: _run_backup: [BEHAVIOR] The run's backup step MUST have copy_store_snapshot copy registry_store to a new temporary path, take the key give_backup_key gives, make the BackupRecord from the imported BACKUP_RECORD_VERSION constant, the StoreSnapshot's fixed_at as its made_at and its last_sequence_number, the imported RELEASE_VERSION constant and _key_digest of the key, write _encrypt_backup of the copy's bytes into a second new temporary file, and remove the unencrypted copy, with each companion file whose path is the copy's path followed by a suffix of the imported STORE_COMPANION_SUFFIXES constant, before going on; when copy_store_snapshot answers SnapshotFailed, the step MUST remove what it wrote at that path before it reports.
open_points.question: Must the every-file rule exclude files opened internally by copy_store_snapshot, or must copy_store_snapshot expose a file-descriptor operation that can use _open_without_link?

open_points.subject: _run_backup
open_points.text: _run_backup: [PATH_OR_ARTIFACT_POLICY] MUST touch in backup_dir only regular files directly in it whose name begins with the imported BACKUP_KEPT_PREFIX constant or the imported BACKUP_TEMPORARY_PREFIX constant, MUST follow no symbolic link, opening every file through _open_without_link, and enter no directory there, and MUST create each temporary file exclusively under the temporary prefix with a name no other file has; it MUST write nothing to the store and make no audit entry.
open_points.other_text: _run_backup: [BEHAVIOR] The backup step MUST then read the written backup back from its file, decrypt it with _decrypt_backup into a third new temporary file, have check_store_file check that file against the recorded last sequence number, and remove that file with each companion file whose path is its path followed by a suffix of the imported STORE_COMPANION_SUFFIXES constant, whatever the check answered; the backup MUST be renamed to its kept name only when the snapshot, the encryption, the decryption and the check passed and both unencrypted files were removed, and otherwise the step MUST delete the backup when it can, leaving it under its temporary name when the decrypted file cannot be removed, and report the MAKE_BACKUP member of = models.BackupRunStep, a file it cannot remove or delete staying under the temporary prefix for the next run.
open_points.question: Must the every-file rule exclude the file opening performed internally by check_store_file, or must check_store_file accept an already safely opened file descriptor?
